response.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT e.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance a JOIN event e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event GROUP BY e.status) SELECT status, attendance_count, CAST(attendance_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(attendance_count) FROM per_status) AS share FROM per_status;

assumptions.assumption: The inner JOIN drops attendance rows whose link_to_event has no matching event, and each remaining attendance row counts once, so COUNT(*) gives the number of attendance entries per event status.

Events with a NULL status form their own group, which the query includes, and status values are already consistent in casing (Open/Closed/Planning). The documentation does not say how NULL or variant spellings should be handled.
